scope: Add restrained bone-white details to Tyrant and Ruin, matching the material of Predator’s bone plates while preserving each form’s distinct silhouette, palette and scenes.
preserved: Predator art is unchanged. Tyrant remains the only crowned form. Ruin remains crownless.
style: Square dark gothic anime fantasy with charcoal silhouettes, ember or spectral violet lighting, no text or UI.

assets.promptSummary: Localized matte ivory bone plates on one massive shoulder, a forearm and a few knuckles, keeping the basalt body and war diadem visually dominant.
assets.review: The ivory accents are visibly related to Predator’s pale bone plates while remaining localized and consistent with this form’s silhouette. Tyrant keeps the only crown; Ruin remains crownless.
